title: Closed symmetric monoidal dualizability criterion
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], and work in D(O_X) [def-pc-derived-category] with derived tensor product [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves] and derived internal Hom R\mathcal Hom [def-pur-derived-internal-hom], related by the tensor-internal-Hom adjunction and the symmetry isomorphism of [lem-sc-derived-internal-hom-adjunction]. Let K and D be objects of D(O_X) and let e:D\otimes^L K\to O_X be a morphism. For an object M of D(O_X) let \varphi_M:M\otimes^L D\to R\mathcal Hom_{O_X}(K,M) be the morphism corresponding under the adjunction to 1_M\otimes e:M\otimes^L D\otimes^L K\to M\otimes^L O_X=M. If \varphi_M is an isomorphism for every object M of D(O_X), let \eta:O_X\to K\otimes^L D be the unique morphism with \varphi_K\circ\eta equal to the morphism O_X\to R\mathcal Hom_{O_X}(K,K) corresponding under the adjunction to \mathrm{id}_K:O_X\otimes^L K=K\to K. Then (e,\eta) satisfy both triangle identities (1_K\otimes e)\circ(\eta\otimes 1_K)=\mathrm{id}_K and (e\otimes 1_D)\circ(1_D\otimes\eta)=\mathrm{id}_D (unit isomorphisms O_X\otimes^L-\cong-\cong-\otimes^L O_X suppressed).
